issues.what: Chiyo's letter modal stays dead-centre on screen for the whole pre-terrace walk (all 38 frames) while the player moves, covering about 35% of the view, including the stairs and the bridge the walk is supposed to show. The player keeps moving underneath it, so it is unclear whether input goes to the world or to the card, and the 'Fold it away x' link is a tiny grey target that will lose taps to the scene.
issues.where: walk0_desktop 000-037, centre card at roughly x 605-1067, y 294-648
issues.fix: Pause movement while the letter is open and require dismissal (E, Esc, or a full-width button), or auto-fold it into the phone after the first input. Make the dismiss control a real button with a large hit area.

issues.what: In the walk before the terrace, the player never climbs the stairs or reaches the bridge. The log shows a final y of 0.12, and the last frames (036-037) are pressed nose-first into a dark shutter or wall. The stairs carry no affordance: no prompt, no highlight, and the HUD objective says 'Open the shutter', not 'go up'.
issues.fix: Add a ground-level cue at the stair foot (lit step edge, lantern, or waypoint chevron). Make the stairs walk-up without needing precise alignment (a ramp collider). Check that the camera cannot clip flush against walls.

issues.what: The terrace is empty. In every walk1 frame the 3 tables and about 7 red stools on the bridge have cups on them but no seated customers. All the crowd (about 6-8 pedestrians) is down on the street outside the yatai. The 'customers seated' state is not visible, so the terrace reads as a prop set, not a working business.
issues.where: walk1_desktop 015-030, bridge end around x 750-900, y 545-630
issues.fix: Seat at least 2-4 customers on the terrace stools with idle animation (sipping, steam from cups, umbrella leaning). Route the street crowd up the stairs to the terrace so it reads as the destination.

issues.what: Serving spots cannot be told apart. Tables, stools and cups are small dark-brown silhouettes behind heavy rain streaks and a bright white lamp bloom right next to them. Nothing (ring, glow, order bubble, E prompt) marks a table as servable, and from 15 m it reads as background decoration.
issues.where: walk1_desktop 015-030 (bridge end); reveal_unlock 000-027 (left, behind railing at y about 300-330)
issues.fix: Give each serving spot an always-on diegetic marker: a warm lantern pool on the deck, a floating order or teacup icon when a customer waits, and an 'E Serve' prompt within reach. Cut the white lamp bloom next to the tables, or move it above them.

issues.what: The terrace furniture is laid out across the bridge deck in the line of travel. 3 tables with stools spread across most of the walkway width at the bridge end leave a narrow gap along the right parapet, with no visible lane. The player never walks into it in the capture, which suggests the path is unclear or blocked.
issues.fix: Keep a clear walking lane at least 1.2 m wide (mark it with deck boards or a runner rug) and push the tables against the parapet. Make the stool colliders smaller than their visuals so they do not snag movement.

issues.what: The unlock moment shows nothing being unlocked. The camera is locked on Gen-san's back in a narrow balcony corridor. The new terrace is only a dim sliver behind a railing on the left, and the dialogue box (y 340-450) covers half of it. The accompanying toast talks about 'A new section on the tea counter, for the new tea', which is unrelated to the terrace.
issues.fix: On unlock, cut or pan to a framed shot of the terrace (lamps switching on, first customer sitting down), then return control. Move the dialogue box so it does not cover the reveal. Make the toast say what opened: 'Bridge terrace open: 6 seats'.

issues.what: Gen-san stands in the middle of a corridor about 1 body-width wide, blocking the only path. The crosshair ring sits on his head, so any click or E will talk to him instead of moving past. His name tag 'Gen-san' is half hidden behind the controls hint bar.
issues.where: reveal_unlock 003-027, centre (Gen-san at x about 390-450; hint bar y 275-310)
issues.fix: Move Gen-san to one side or into a doorway after the dialogue, or let the player pass through NPCs. Place the controls hint at the bottom edge and keep it clear of name tags. Hide the hint once WASD has been pressed.

issues.what: The objectives contradict each other and the HUD is noisy. The reveal sets 'CHAPTER 3 Start the renovation at the holo-model table', but walk1 shows 'CHAPTER 3 Save Y160,000 and stock 30 roasted portions'. Neither mentions serving the terrace. The money counter reads 200,000 in the reveal but 100,000 in walk1. A '8 m down' waypoint diamond appears bottom-right with no matching marker in the world.
issues.where: HUD objective pill (top centre) and bottom-right waypoint, reveal_unlock vs walk1_desktop
issues.fix: After unlock, give one objective that names the terrace ('Serve your first terrace customer'). Pin the waypoint to a visible world marker on the terrace. Make sure money and chapter state carry over between sequences.

issues.what: The walk1 capture ends with the camera turned around and pressed into a dark wall or window at the top of the stairs (033-034). This suggests the stair landing turns sharply or snaps the camera around, which disorients the player at the exact point of arrival.
issues.fix: Widen the landing, add a guide rail or lit edge that points along the bridge, and keep the camera from facing back into the wall when the player reaches the top.

verdict: The atmosphere is strong but it does not play yet. The pre-terrace walk is hidden behind a modal that never closes, and the player never reaches the bridge. The terrace, once open, has no seated customers and no readable serving spots. The unlock is shown from a corridor with an NPC blocking the path and a toast about the wrong feature. Seat customers, mark serving spots, keep the walking lane clear, and frame the reveal before polishing anything else.
